caption:
We built Growth Terminal because nobody ever fixed a dark house by rewiring it.

When the power goes, an electrician does not start opening walls. They walk to the panel. Every switch in there looks identical and only one of them is thrown. Finding it is the entire job. Everything after that is a flick of a finger.

Growth almost never gets treated that way. Traffic dips, so the team rewrites the ads. Deals stall, so the team rewrites the deck. Retention slips, so the team ships a feature. Four people opening four walls in a house with one thrown switch, and every one of them can show you a chart proving their wall is the right one.

So the mark is one letter with one square held inside it, and that square is the only thing wearing colour.

→ growthterminal.io
first_comment: The panel metaphor is the product, not a flourish. It ranks what is holding the rest back and tells you what would prove it wrong before you spend anything acting on it.
